description: Two separated source boundary components of4 and1 unit edges fit one D placement under a common rigid map. The opposite wall and the4-link missing-corner stair jointly constrain a four-cell connector plus offset branch, whereas the old E stair alone had no opposite boundary anchor. Wrong D is predicted from mistaking this joint local exterior fit for a full3-copy partition.
